scope: Independent external retrospective research for review-escalation generalization; no clinical or deployment claim

search_policy.source_priority: official publisher, repository, license, or dataset paper

dossiers.publisher: BRSET authors / PhysioNet / MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology
dossiers.redistribution_rights: No onward sharing; credentialed access only; protected-data obligations continue after termination
dossiers.research_use_rights: Lawful scientific research and education only after credentialing, current human-subject/HIPAA training, and signed DUA
dossiers.commercial_restrictions: Not cleared for commercial use, clinical deployment, or redistribution
dossiers.citation_requirement: PhysioNet v1.0.2 DOI 10.13026/mysn-8b26 plus the BRSET PLOS Digital Health publication and PhysioNet acknowledgement
dossiers.patient_ids_available: yes: patient_id is documented by the official data description, but the files were not accessible in this run
dossiers.eye_ids_available: yes: exam_eye is documented; v1.0.2 reviewed OD/OS mapping
dossiers.laterality_available: yes: exam_eye 1=right and 2=left according to the v1.0.2 data description
dossiers.device_camera_available: yes: camera field; Nikon NF505 and Canon CR-2
dossiers.country_site_available: Brazil; three ophthalmological centers in Sao Paulo
dossiers.ground_truth: Retinal-specialist labels; ICDR and Scottish DR grading fields; additional pathology and quality fields
dossiers.grade_semantics: DR_ICDR 0-4: 0 none, 1 mild NPDR, 2 moderate NPDR, 3 severe NPDR, 4 proliferative/post-laser; grade >=2 is a predeclared research reference condition only
dossiers.lesion_labels: Image-level diabetic-retinopathy and other pathology labels; no pixel lesion annotations documented in the official data description
dossiers.quality_labels: focus, illumination, image_field, and artifacts; each documented as normal/abnormal
dossiers.training_overlap_risk: No BRSET source is named in either installed model's publisher-reported training list, but exact model-training manifests are unavailable; residual overlap cannot be mathematically excluded
dossiers.known_model_training_overlap: None named; DR list is EyePACS/APTOS/DDR/IDRiD and lesion list is DDR/FGADR/IDRiD/MESSIDOR/RETLES
dossiers.decision_reason: Strongest endpoint and grouping match, but files are restricted to credentialed users who complete CITI training and sign the DUA. No authorized credential, downloaded files, external D: data root, or file manifest was present; no inference was permitted.
dossiers.expected_scale: 16,266 images from 8,524 patients according to the official v1.0.2 description; not treated as a local denominator

dossiers.license: CC-BY 4.0 as stated in the dataset paper
dossiers.redistribution_rights: Attribution terms require verification against the live download terms before any data or derivative redistribution
dossiers.research_use_rights: Research access is publicly described; exact current platform terms were not relied on for acquisition
dossiers.commercial_restrictions: Not inferred from public availability; separate current terms review required
dossiers.citation_requirement: Panchal et al., RFMiD 2.0, Data 2023, DOI 10.3390/data8020029
dossiers.patient_ids_available: not documented in the published data fields; only image identity is specified
dossiers.device_camera_available: cohort-level camera information exists: TOPCON 3D OCT-2000, Kowa VX-10alpha, TOPCON TRC-NW300; per-image device association requires verification
dossiers.country_site_available: India; Nanded sites described in the dataset paper
dossiers.grade_semantics: Binary DR presence is documented; ICDR grade 0-4 and referable/high-grade labels are not provided by the published RFMiD specification
dossiers.lesion_labels: Image-level disease/pathology labels; no compatible pixel-level four-class lesion annotation for the frozen segmentation rule
dossiers.quality_labels: Low/high-quality images are described, but no frozen per-image quality field sufficient for this protocol was established

dossiers.research_use_rights: Research evaluation permitted by the acquired archive terms
dossiers.commercial_restrictions: Not used for commercial or clinical claims
dossiers.citation_requirement: Porwal et al., Indian diabetic retinopathy image dataset (IDRiD), Data 2018

dossiers.license: Free of charge for research and educational purposes under publisher conditions
dossiers.research_use_rights: Research and educational use permitted after the publisher download form/process

primary_candidate.selection_basis: Only reviewed candidate with documented patient_id, eye/laterality, camera, quality fields, and ICDR 0-4 labels that match the planned endpoint; rights are research-only and credentialed.
primary_candidate.stop_reason: No authorized credentialed BRSET access was available. Proceeding without the files would violate denominator, rights, provenance, and overlap requirements.
primary_candidate.next_gate: A human-authorized researcher must complete required training, sign the BRSET DUA, obtain the exact v1.0.2 files, and place them in an ignored D: research-data root before manifesting or inference.

non_stage1_image_scope: Non-PHI engineering fixtures and historical overlap-disclosed evaluation files are outside the Stage 1 manifest and were not used as Stage 1 validation cases.
